build_deepseek_mtp_model: build a DeepSeek multi-token predictor model for speculative decoding using vLLM config
create_shared_head: create a shared head with RMSNorm and parallel LM head for token prediction
create_mtp_layer: create a DeepSeek multi-token predictor layer that normalizes and projects inputs through a decoder block
run_mtp_forward: run the multi-token predictor forward pass to generate hidden states for speculative decoding steps
load_mtp_weights: load DeepSeek MTP model weights from checkpoint with support for fused MoE and expert splitting
